description: Make a version of a hosted model the active one: the next call to every function that runs this model uses it, with no change to callers. The version that was active is retired and stays available to roll back to. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.

version.description: The version number: version on a get_hosted_model result.

name: promote_hosted_model_version
